entries.source: Where on this device a session move may create or restore a repository: folders under your home, written with ~ and separated by commas (for example ~/code, ~/work). Hidden, system, command (on PATH) and node_modules folders are never used. Unset: a repository is restored where it already is, and a missing one is cloned only into a folder that already holds your repositories; set this to allow other folders.
